programme.title: Resúmenes Mundial: España - Argentina
programme.desc: Los encuentros del Mundial 2026 comprimidos en pocos minutos para no perderse nada de lo que ocurra en la cita de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Argentina - Cabo Verde
programme.desc: El Mundial más grande de la historia ya está aquí. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA cuenta por primera vez con 48 equipos en busca de la gloria. Estados Unidos, México y Canadá se convierten en el epicentro del planeta fútbol del 11 de junio al 19 de julio.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: España - Bélgica
programme.desc: España está entre los ocho mejores equipos del Mundial, pero no se conforma. El conjunto de Luis de la Fuente pretende alcanzar las semifinales, algo que solo ocurrió en Sudáfrica. La cita con la historia es en Los Ángeles y el rival, Bélgica.

programme.title: DAZN Mundial
programme.desc: La gesta de los campeones del mundo se merece una fiesta por todo lo alto. Las calles de Madrid se vuelcan con los héroes de Nueva York que consiguieron tejer la segunda estrella en el escudo de la Selección Española.

programme.title: Bordando la segunda estrella
programme.desc: La Selección ha hecho historia en el Mundial. La cita de México, Canadá y Estados Unidos quedará guardada por siempre en la memoria de la afición española. El combinado dirigido por Luis de la Fuente alzó en Nueva York la copa y bordó la segunda estrella en el escudo.

programme.title: Resúmenes Mundial: Francia - España
programme.desc: Los encuentros del Mundial 2026 comprimidos en pocos minutos para no perderse nada de lo que ocurra en la cita de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá.

programme.title: Resúmenes Mundial: Inglaterra - Argentina
programme.desc: Los encuentros del Mundial 2026 comprimidos en pocos minutos para no perderse nada de lo que ocurra en la cita de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá.

programme.title: Resúmenes Mundial: España - Argentina
programme.desc: Los encuentros del Mundial 2026 comprimidos en pocos minutos para no perderse nada de lo que ocurra en la cita de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Alemania - Paraguay
programme.desc: El Mundial más grande de la historia ya está aquí. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA cuenta por primera vez con 48 equipos en busca de la gloria. Estados Unidos, México y Canadá se convierten en el epicentro del planeta fútbol del 11 de junio al 19 de julio.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: España - Austria
programme.desc: Llega la hora de la verdad para España. La Selección inicia las eliminatorias del Mundial, los partidos en los que o ganas o te vas para casa. En los dieciseisavos de final, Austria pone a prueba a los de Luis de la Fuente en Los Ángeles.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Francia - España

programme.title: Good Morning Britain
programme.desc: Morning magazine featuring a lively mix of news and current affairs, plus health, entertainment and lifestyle features.

programme.title: This Morning
programme.desc: Daily magazine, featuring a mix of celebrity chat, showbusiness news, lifestyle features, topical discussion, health and beauty advice and more.

programme.title: ITV Lunchtime News; Weather
programme.desc: The key headlines from the day so far.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: David Dickinson and the team are at Newcastle racecourse, where a diamond and gold necklace has Henry Nicholls digging deep, and Helen Gardiner has to weigh up the odds as she is confronted with a pair of jockey scales.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Carolyn tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Ben from Swindon, Kieran from Rawtenstall, Fi from Dorset and Roxy from Sheffield pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: STV News at Six and Weather
programme.desc: Including regional weather forecast.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: What's on Scotland
programme.desc: Movie news, chat about favourite TV programmes, and music. Plus, catch-ups with some of the biggest names in worldwide entertainment.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Cain is trapped, while Dawn is not happy about Billy dating Gabby and there are worries for Kev when an old face turns up.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Maria struggles with the impact of Gary's involvement as Sarah finally confesses to killing Theo, while news of Harper and Sam's homecoming provides the Platts with respite.

programme.title: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
programme.desc: As Amanda, Raffaele, and Patrick Lumumba enter prison, Giuliano Mignini, their prosecutor, continues to build his case against them while the media's reporting turns Amanda into a monster.

programme.title: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
programme.desc: A wrench is thrown in Mignini's case and the search for a new suspect begins. As the highly anticipated trial unfolds, Amanda's choices continue to be scrutinised by the Press. Drama, starring Grace Van Patten.

programme.title: ITV News; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: Inside the Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: Documentary following chefs, engineers and hoteliers at the central London hotel as they pull off glittering events, luxury renovations and culinary challenges while battling to ensure that the heritage destination stands out in a fierce-five star market. As Michel Roux hosts the biggest dinner of the year, chef Oliver must manage a culinary crisis, while Alice prepares a £10,000 a night suite for a demanding guest, and twin engineers Alan and Trevor take a leap of faith to light up the Langham. Maureen Lipman narrates.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: With fewer players left and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable, while Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. Whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths/shooting-led challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage. Strategic reality quiz, hosted by Emily Atack and Danny Dyer.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Both stories in this episode celebrate the bond between brothers. In the first case, Lee Sharp's adoptive parents had told him that he was a foundling, but the team discovers this isn't true and a sibling he never knew he had. In the second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station. After 58 years of longing, Peter wants to see his brother again.

programme.title: Unwind with STV
programme.desc: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: The chef rides his motorbike through the coastal city of Santa Cruz, California. He shops at local farmers' markets before cooking his recipes on a family run artichoke farm. James also tries his hand at surfing, but gets upstaged by a dog.

programme.title: Diamonds Are Forever
programme.desc: James Bond investigates a diamond-smuggling operation, and discovers that behind the scheme is his insidious arch-enemy Blofeld, who is planning to construct a devastating orbital doomsday weapon powered by the precious stones, which will force world powers to disarm and give him global domination. Spy adventure, starring Sean Connery, Jill St John, Charles Gray, Bernard Lee and Lois Maxwell.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James rustles up a couple of delicious recipes for singer Michael Ball and enjoys dishes from chefs Galton Blackiston, Ruth Hansom and Glynn Purnell.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue cooks a range of recipes perfect for entertaining guests before welcoming her Great British Bake Off colleague Alison Hammond into her kitchen. Prue makes two recipes using watermelon to demonstrate its versatility, and hears from a group of friends producing smoked salmon.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: STV Racing: Live from Ascot
programme.desc: Francesca Cumani and Ed Chamberlin present coverage of a meeting headlined by the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Stakes from Ascot, plus racing from York. With analysis from Jason Weaver and Adele Mulrennan, reports by Matt Chapman and Mick Fitzgerald, and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee
programme.desc: A Victorian widower struggles to control his seven unruly children, who have already driven a series of childminders to distraction. But a strange-looking nanny with a few tricks up her sleeve soon gets the youngsters into line, leaving their weary father to concentrate on finding a new wife. Period fantasy adventure, starring Emma Thompson, Colin Firth and Kelly Macdonald.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: Compilation of some of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as comedian and actor Guz Khan tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a cash prize for charity. Guz is supported in the wings by his friends, family and a few famous faces, including some of his Man Like Mobeen castmates.

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
programme.desc: Another line-up of contestants answer questions that could change their lives - with the four lifelines Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend, 50-50 and Ask the Host available to them if they get stuck. Jeremy Clarkson hosts.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: When businesswoman Kathleen Peterson is found dead after reportedly falling down a flight of stairs at her North Carolina home, the unusually bloody scene leads police to focus their attention on her husband, author and aspiring local politician Michael Peterson. While the Petersons' blended family rallies around the patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture perfect marriage into question. Fact-based drama, starring Colin Firth and Toni Collette.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. As teams of forensic experts on both sides recreate the night of Kathleen's death, Michael's children grapple with shocking new information about their father, while his stepdaughter Caitlin wrestles with her own doubts.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Charlene White, Shazia Mirza, Jessica Fostekew and Stephen K Amos join team leaders Chizzy Akudolu and Eddie Kadi to answer questions about black history. Jimmy Akingbola hosts.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: The pressure intensifies as the final looms, with a quiz producing unexpected results and valuation descending into chaos as accusations fly and the vote collapses into deadlock. When a rule is broken, Danny Dyer and Emily Atack are forced to intervene, triggering a dramatic reversal and a shocking exit. A final quiz redraws the leaderboard before players are offered the chance to leave immediately with their winnings.

programme.title: Unwind with STV
programme.desc: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern Britton returns to the Grove Vets in Bristol for an insight into the running of a busy practice at the heart of the local community. Pets brought in include a Romanian rescue dog with a lump in his mouth, a floppy-eared Doberman with a sore paw, and a pair of lively cavalier King Charles spaniel sisters who are due to be spayed. Fern lends a hand in the much-needed grooming of a long-haired cat.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: The chef's culinary journey takes him to the city of San Francisco, where he explores the city's famous Chinatown and many of the food stores offering a range of unusual ingredients to the thousands of shoppers that visit everyday. The chef then visits the Ghiradelli Chocolate Festival, which celebrates sweet delicacies in a uniquely Californian way.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James rustles up a couple of delicious recipes for singer Michael Ball and enjoys dishes from chefs Galton Blackiston, Ruth Hansom and Glynn Purnell.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Singer Petula Clark talks about her long career, actress Fiona Dolman discusses Midsomer Murders, and former NHS doctor-turned-comedian and author Adam Kay chats about the power of laughter. Plus, a look the ancient art of horseback falconry, and the best in British chardonnay.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern witnesses the castration of a Bengal cat, and meets Amy the golden retriever and her devoted owner ahead of surgery to remove a lump from the dog's mouth. Later, 12-week-old Labrador retriever puppy Tassie is brought in for a vaccination, and returning canine patients Mono and Marley visit James for their one-year boosters.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Tom explores Tuscany and Lazio, discovering traditional olive oil production and modern rocket cultivation. He joins the olive harvest, samples the season's first pressing, then cooks fig and extra virgin olive oil cake and rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with pesto pasta salad inspired by the region's prized ingredients.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team head to Suffolk to transform a garden for charity worker Eileen, who is desperate for a peaceful outdoor space to spend time with her husband Roy, who suffers from Parkinson's. Alan designs an inward-looking intimate area surrounded by beautiful year round colour for Roy and Eileen to enjoy, while Katie Rushworth takes inspiration from their love of pinks and blues to plant a wrap-around border.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Live and Let Die
programme.desc: James Bond's investigation into the murder of three British agents leads him to a connection between the dictator of a Caribbean island and a notorious Harlem drug kingpin - along with a plot to flood America with limitless supplies of free heroin. Spy adventure, with Roger Moore in his first appearance as 007, alongside Yaphet Kotto and Jane Seymour.

programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.sub-title: Jayde Adams, Tony Cottee, Naughty Boy and the Vivienne
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Jayde Adams, Tony Cottee, Naughty Boy and the Vivienne pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: The Chase Around the World
programme.desc: The teams land in Barcelona to take on the Vixen and the Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley Walsh at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last. If they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city, lose and it's the first flight home.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.desc: Andrew Lincoln narrates a look at animals' battle for survival as climate change intensifies and the weather becomes more extreme. An owl on the American prairies uses its extraordinary hearing and underground burrows to save its chicks, while two cheetahs in Kenya face record-breaking floods, and a polar bear loses the summer sea ice it relies on.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Gabby has a medical check-up after collapsing, while Kev's mate Steve thinks the village is a gold mine.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Sarah tips off David and Shona about Jodie's box of secrets, Leanne introduces Sam to Idris, Steve disapproves of Cassie's plot to discredit Ross, and Ben finds Ollie working for the competition.

programme.title: The Dark

programme.title: Terror in the Skies: Stopping the Liquid Bomb Plot
programme.desc: Rohit Kachroo looks at the thwarted Al-Qaeda-linked 2006 terrorist conspiracy, when British plotters tried to tried to smuggle liquid explosives onto multiple transatlantic airliners and destroy them over the Atlantic or when they reached North America. Featuring interviews with those at the heart of the operation, many speaking for the first time, this documentary uncovers the secret story behind the plot that transformed global air travel, with groundbreaking AI reconstructions helping bring the investigation and its key turning points vividly to life.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk

He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: Spurred on by their wives' insistence that their children attend summer camp, daycare entrepreneurs Charlie Hinton (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and his friend Phil (Paul Rae) decide to buy their dilapidated alma mater, Camp Driftwood. Charlie asks his estranged father for help in restoring Driftwood's former glory.

programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old, hoops-loving Calvin Cambridge has a dream: to be a famous basketball player -- to mix it up among the NBA's greatest. programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules.
